zh.q_none: 还没有额度读数（派过活后才有）
zh.q_early: 记录不到 6 小时，还不能推算
zh.q_proj: 按现在的速度，到重置时 {p}%
zh.empty: 现在没有在做的事。派过活之后，这里会显示谁在做什么。
zh.ov_nothing: 一切正常，没有要你做的事
zh.ov_quota_bad: {a} 的额度按现在的速度会在重置前用到 {p}%，新活少派给它
zh.leads_now: 现在的组长（最近 15 分钟有动静的对话）
zh.week_spent: 最近 7 天子智能体花了约 {u}（{n} 次运行，按 API 价格折算；订阅用户实际付的是额度）。
zh.week_cash: 其中真钱 {u}（按 token 付费的服务）。
zh.saved_see_report: 确认过的结果够多了，省了多少见 ccx report。
zh.saved_unknown: 省了多少：还不知道（需要约 {need} 次确认，现在 {n} 次）。
zh.snap_banner: 这是 {at} 生成的快照，不会自动更新。
zh.offline_banner: 连不上 ccx ui 了（可能已经退出）。在终端里重新运行 ccx ui。
zh.in_split: 拆成 {n} 块：{d} 完成 · {r} 在做 · {k} 等你
zh.needs_more: 还有 {n} 件 → 只看要我处理的
zh.boss_unknown: 你直接派的（没有组长对话）
zh.helper: 组长自带的子智能体 ×{n}（最近 15 分钟）
zh.legend: 每一列是一个干活的 · 红框 = 要你拍板 · 橙框 = 要你 review · 虚线 = 自带子智能体 · 新加的智能体会自动多一列
zh.d_native: {w} 自己开的子智能体（不经过 ccx 选模型；花费算在这一块里，审查也和这一块一起做）：
zh.pick: 点图上任何一块看它的详情；红框、橙框的是要你处理的，这里会显示原因、依据和可以运行的命令。
zh.why_bad: 哪里不对？（会记进这次的结果，选模型能学到）
zh.will_run: 要运行的命令（第一期只显示，复制到终端或交给组长运行）：
zh.no_token: 这个网址缺少口令。请用 ccx ui 在终端里打印的完整网址打开（# 后面那一段就是口令）。
zh.a_needs_write: 只读任务说要改文件才能做完
zh.a_review_failed: 独立审查改过一轮，还是不过
zh.a_check_failed: 说做完了，但验收命令没过
zh.a_review: 做完了，等你确认对不对
zh.w_stale: {m} 分钟没有写入任何东西，可能卡住了。可以先看它最后做到哪。
zh.w_needs_write: 这块按只读派出去，所以它没动文件，只写下了想改什么、为什么。要不要让它改，由你决定。
zh.w_review_failed: 另一家的模型（{by}）审查后仍认为有问题。再改一轮还要再花一点额度，所以先问你。
zh.w_check_failed: ccx 重新运行了验收命令 {cmd}，退出码 {exit}。
zh.w_quota: 等额度恢复后可以接着做（恢复时间：{at}）。会话保留着，续跑不会从头开始。
zh.w_timeout: 超过了时间上限。会话保留着，可以接着做。
zh.w_over_budget: 自带子智能体合计花费超过了上限，ccx 把它停了。
zh.w_auth: {agent} 在这台电脑上好像没登录，需要你登录一次。
zh.w_failed: 子智能体没完成这块，看看它说了什么再决定重试还是自己做。
zh.h_review_issues: 审查发现问题（{by}），交回去改
zh.h_review_failed: “{t}”改了一轮仍不过审查 → 等你拍板
zh.disc_none: 还没有讨论。组长遇到选错代价高的决定时会先问你，同意后运行 `ccx discuss`。
zh.disc_two: 只有两家：出方案的一方兼任裁判
zh.hint_queue: ccx 队列：这个项目有 {n} 块没做完，{r} 块可以开始 —— `ccx q tree` 看，`ccx q run` 继续
zh.hint_mem_suggest: [ccx 共享记忆：有 {n} 条建议记下的事等你决定（偏好、决定、踩过的坑）：`ccx mem suggestions`，同意 `ccx mem accept N`，不要 `ccx mem reject N`]
zh.hint_mem_stale: [ccx 共享记忆：{n} 条笔记 {days}+ 天没核对过，当作“待核对”：`ccx mem stale`]
zh.hint_waiting: [ccx：{n} 件派出去的活等你处理（确认结果或拍板）—— `ccx ui` 打开看]
zh.hint_context: [ccx] 这个对话每一轮都要重读约 {k}k token（约 ${usd} 一轮，已 {turns} 轮）。往后更省的做法：大段阅读（很多文件、日志、调研）交给子智能体，只拿回结论；如果接下来是新的一件事，换一个新对话接着做：先问一下用户，再运行 `ccx fresh`（它从这个对话的文件写好交接；在这个文件夹里开的新对话会从它开始）。

en.q_none: No quota readings yet (they come with delegated runs)
en.q_early: less than 6 h of readings: too early to project
en.empty: Nothing is being worked on right now. Once work is delegated, this shows who does what.
en.ov_quota_bad: at this pace {a}'s quota reaches {p}% before it resets, so send it less
en.leads_now: Leads now (conversations active in the last 15 minutes)
en.week_spent: Sub-agents cost about {u} in the last 7 days ({n} runs, at API prices; on a subscription you pay in quota).
en.week_cash: Of that, {u} is real money (pay-per-token services).
en.saved_see_report: Enough verdicts to tell: see ccx report for how much was saved.
en.saved_unknown: Saved so far: not known yet (needs about {need} verdicts, there are {n}).
en.snap_banner: A snapshot made at {at}; it does not update.
en.offline_banner: Can't reach ccx ui (it may have exited). Run ccx ui again in a terminal.
en.in_split: split into {n}: {d} done · {r} running · {k} for you
en.boss_unknown: Sent by you directly (no lead conversation)
en.legend: Each column is one worker · red frame = your call · amber frame = please review · dashed = own sub-agents · a newly added agent gets its own column
en.d_native: Sub-agents {w} started itself (not routed by ccx; their cost is part of this piece, and they are reviewed with it):
en.pick: Click any block for its details; red and amber ones need you, and this panel shows why, the evidence and the command to run.
en.why_bad: What's wrong? (recorded with the result, so model choice learns)
en.will_run: the command to run (phase 1 only shows it: copy it to a terminal or hand it to the lead):
en.no_token: This address has no token. Open the full address ccx ui printed in the terminal (the part after # is the token).
en.a_stale: No sign of life for a while
en.a_needs_write: A read-only piece says files must change
en.a_review_failed: Still fails review after one round of fixes
en.a_check_failed: Says it's done, but the check fails
en.a_q_needs_write: A read-only piece says files must change
en.w_stale: Nothing written for {m} minutes; it may be stuck. See how far it got first.
en.w_needs_write: It was sent out read-only, so it changed nothing and wrote down what it would change and why. Whether it may edit is your call.
en.w_review_failed: Another vendor's model ({by}) still finds problems. Another round costs a little more quota, so it asks you first.
en.w_check_failed: ccx ran the check {cmd} again: exit {exit}.
en.w_quota: It can continue once quota is back (at {at}). The session is kept, so resuming does not start over.
en.w_timeout: It ran past the time limit. The session is kept and can continue.
en.w_over_budget: Its own sub-agents went over the spending cap, so ccx stopped it.
en.w_auth: {agent} seems logged out on this machine: log in once.
en.w_failed: The sub-agent did not finish; read what it says, then retry or do it yourself.
en.h_review_issues: review found problems ({by}); sent back to fix
en.h_needs_write: "{t}" says files must change → your call
en.h_review_failed: "{t}" still fails review after a fix round → your call
en.disc_none: No discussions yet. When a decision is costly to get wrong, the lead asks you first and runs `ccx discuss` on your yes.
en.disc_two: two vendors only: the proposer also judges
en.hint_queue: ccx queue: {n} open item(s) in this project, {r} ready — `ccx q tree` to see them, `ccx q run` to continue
en.hint_mem_suggest: [ccx shared memory: {n} suggested note(s) wait for your yes or no (preferences, decisions, pitfalls): `ccx mem suggestions`, then `ccx mem accept N` or `ccx mem reject N`]
en.hint_mem_stale: [ccx shared memory: {n} note(s) not checked for {days}+ days — treat them as 'to check': `ccx mem stale`]
en.hint_waiting: [ccx: {n} delegated piece(s) wait for you (a verdict or a decision) — `ccx ui` to see them]
en.hint_context: [ccx] This conversation re-reads about {k}k tokens every turn (≈ ${usd} a turn, {turns} turns so far). Cheaper from here: send big reads (many files, logs, research) to a sub-agent and take back only its conclusion; and if what comes next is a new piece of work, hand over to a fresh conversation: ask the person, then run `ccx fresh` (it writes the handoff from this conversation's file; a new conversation in this folder starts with it).
